You are a senior data engineer generating the Silver layer of a medallion-architecture dbt plan.

Given a schema and pipeline context, produce a plan with:
  - bronze: list of ALL source table names (raw names only, no prefixes)
  - dimensions: Silver dimension models (dim_<entity>, SCD type 1 or 2)
  - facts: Silver fact models (fct_<entity>)

Rules:
  - Every source table must appear in bronze.
  - source_table in dimensions/facts must match a table name in bronze.
  - Dimension names: dim_<entity>. Fact names: fct_<entity>.
  - Choose SCD type 2 for slowly-changing entities (customers, employees); type 1 for others.
  - STRICT: Only create fct_* from tables whose role is "fact". Never create a fact from a
    dimension, bridge, or reference table.
  - STRICT: `columns` in every DimensionPlan MUST be an empty list []. Do not enumerate columns.
  - STRICT: fact `dimension_keys` must be FK columns that physically exist on the source table.
  - STRICT: fact `date_column` must be an actual date/timestamp column on the source table.
    If no date column exists on the table, look at its FK-referenced tables. If a parent table
    has a date/timestamp column (e.g. invoice_date on invoice), set date_column to that column
    name — the generator will add the JOIN automatically. Only use "" if no date is reachable
    via a single FK hop.
  - STRICT: fact `measures` must contain ONLY bare column names of numeric type (int, num/decimal,
    money). Column types are shown in the schema as :int, :num, :money. Do NOT include
    varchar, text, guid, bool, or :char columns as measures — they are identifiers, not metrics.
    Do NOT put SQL expressions in `measures`.
  - DERIVED MEASURES: When a business metric must be computed from multiple columns (e.g. revenue
    from quantity × price), use `derived_measures` instead of putting expressions in `measures`.
    Each entry has a `name` (SQL alias, e.g. "line_total") and `expression` (SQL-valid expression
    using only column names that exist on the source table, e.g. "orderqty * unitprice").
    Derived measures are rendered as `expression AS name` in the fact SELECT and are exposed to
    Gold as named columns. Common cases:
      - Revenue without a total column: {"name": "line_total", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice"}
      - Net revenue with discount: {"name": "net_revenue", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice - unitpricediscount"}
      - Good quantity: {"name": "good_qty", "expression": "orderqty - scrappedqty"}
  - Denormalize high-cardinality customer/user FKs (customer_id, user_id, account_id) onto
    the fact directly when reachable via one FK hop, so gold models can group by them.
  - For periodic snapshot tables (tracking inventory levels or balances over time, e.g.
    productinventory), include the snapshot date column in `dimension_keys` so it becomes
    part of the surrogate key and uniqueness tests pass.
  - Factless fact tables (no numeric measures, e.g. employeedepartmenthistory) are valid.
    Set `factless=true` and keep `measures` and `derived_measures` as empty lists.

Database schema:
  organizations: columns=[id, name, slug, description, website_url, logo_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at]
  users: columns=[id, organization_id, email, username, full_name, avatar_url, bio, role, is_active, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at], fks=[organization_id→organizations]
  teams: columns=[id, organization_id, name, slug, description, lead_user_id, is_active, created_at, updated_at], fks=[organization_id→organizations, lead_user_id→users]
  team_members: columns=[id, team_id, user_id, role, joined_at], fks=[team_id→teams, user_id→users]
  repositories: columns=[id, organization_id, name, full_name, description, clone_url, default_branch, is_private, is_active, created_at, updated_at], fks=[organization_id→organizations]
  projects: columns=[id, organization_id, repository_id, name, description, status, visibility, owner_id, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at], fks=[organization_id→organizations, repository_id→repositories, owner_id→users]
  project_members: columns=[id, project_id, user_id, role, joined_at], fks=[project_id→projects, user_id→users]
  milestones: columns=[id, project_id, title, description, status, due_date, completed_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at], fks=[project_id→projects, created_by→users]
  sprints: columns=[id, project_id, name, goal, status, start_date, end_date, velocity, created_by, completed_at, created_at, updated_at], fks=[project_id→projects, created_by→users]
  issue_types: columns=[id, project_id, name, description, icon_url, color, is_default, created_at, updated_at], fks=[project_id→projects]
  issue_statuses: columns=[id, project_id, name, description, category, color, position, is_default, created_at, updated_at], fks=[project_id→projects]
  issue_priorities: columns=[id, name, description, level, color, icon_url, created_at, updated_at]
  workflows: columns=[id, project_id, name, description, is_default, created_at, updated_at], fks=[project_id→projects]
  workflow_transitions: columns=[id, workflow_id, from_status_id, to_status_id, name, requires_comment, created_at, updated_at], fks=[workflow_id→workflows, from_status_id→issue_statuses, to_status_id→issue_statuses]
  issues: columns=[id, project_id, sprint_id, milestone_id, parent_issue_id, issue_type_id, status_id, priority_id, title, description, sequence_number, reporter_id, assignee_id, story_points, estimated_hours], fks=[project_id→projects, sprint_id→sprints, milestone_id→milestones, parent_issue_id→issues, issue_type_id→issue_types, status_id→issue_statuses, priority_id→issue_priorities, reporter_id→users, assignee_id→users]
  labels: columns=[id, project_id, name, color, description, created_at, updated_at], fks=[project_id→projects]
  issue_labels: columns=[id, issue_id, label_id, created_at], fks=[issue_id→issues, label_id→labels]
  comments: columns=[id, issue_id, parent_comment_id, author_id, body, is_edited, edited_at, created_at, updated_at], fks=[issue_id→issues, parent_comment_id→comments, author_id→users]
  attachments: columns=[id, issue_id, comment_id, uploaded_by, file_name, file_size_bytes, mime_type, storage_url, created_at], fks=[issue_id→issues, comment_id→comments, uploaded_by→users]
  time_logs: columns=[id, issue_id, user_id, hours_logged, logged_date, description, created_at, updated_at], fks=[issue_id→issues, user_id→users]
  commits: columns=[id, repository_id, issue_id, author_id, sha, message, author_email, author_name, committed_at, created_at], fks=[repository_id→repositories, issue_id→issues, author_id→users]
  pull_requests: columns=[id, repository_id, issue_id, author_id, reviewer_id, title, description, status, source_branch, target_branch, merge_commit_sha, merged_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at], fks=[repository_id→repositories, issue_id→issues, author_id→users, reviewer_id→users]
  notifications: columns=[id, recipient_id, actor_id, issue_id, comment_id, pull_request_id, type, title, body, is_read, read_at, created_at], fks=[recipient_id→users, actor_id→users, issue_id→issues, comment_id→comments, pull_request_id→pull_requests]

All source tables (all must appear in bronze): ['organizations', 'users', 'teams', 'team_members', 'repositories', 'projects', 'project_members', 'milestones', 'sprints', 'issue_types', 'issue_statuses', 'issue_priorities', 'workflows', 'workflow_transitions', 'issues', 'labels', 'issue_labels', 'comments', 'attachments', 'time_logs', 'commits', 'pull_requests', 'notifications']

Pipeline context:
  Industry: software / saas
  Metrics:  issues_resolved, sprint_velocity, time_logged_hours, pull_request_cycle_time, issue_throughput, story_points_completed
  Goals:    sprint_performance_tracking, team_productivity_analysis, issue_resolution_monitoring, developer_contribution_insights
  Grain:    issue

Table roles (from Agent 3):
  organizations: dimension
  users: dimension
  teams: dimension
  team_members: bridge
  repositories: dimension
  projects: dimension
  project_members: bridge
  milestones: dimension
  sprints: dimension
  issue_types: dimension
  issue_statuses: dimension
  issue_priorities: reference
  workflows: dimension
  workflow_transitions: dimension
  issues: fact
  labels: dimension
  issue_labels: bridge
  comments: fact
  attachments: fact
  time_logs: fact
  commits: fact
  pull_requests: fact
  notifications: fact

Numeric columns eligible as measures (use ONLY these in `measures`):
  issues: estimated_hours, logged_hours
  attachments: file_size_bytes
  time_logs: hours_logged
